# splunkctl acl

Inspect and change knowledge object permissions.

## acl get

Show object permissions and modification capabilities.

```text
splunkctl acl get [OPTIONS] {saved-search|macro|eventtype|tag|props|transform|lookup-definition|lookup-table|field-extraction|data-model|view|dashboard} NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App namespace (default: current). |
| `--owner` | text | - | Owner namespace (default: current). |

## acl set

Preview or apply object permission changes.

> Guarded mutation: dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl acl set [OPTIONS] {saved-search|macro|eventtype|tag|props|transform|lookup-definition|lookup-table|field-extraction|data-model|view|dashboard} NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App namespace (default: current). |
| `--current-owner` | text | - | Current owner namespace. |
| `--sharing` | choice: user, app, global | - |  |
| `--owner` | text | - | New object owner. |
| `--read` | text | - | Read roles, comma-separated; '*' everyone, '' clears. |
| `--write` | text | - | Write roles, comma-separated; '*' everyone, '' clears. |
